candidate_discovery.jsonl: one discovery_row per canonical LF-terminated line
report.md: deterministic UTF-8 LF text generated only from validated exact-ten core and reproduction evidence

common.canonical_object_keys: Exact key sets are mandatory; canonical JSON sorts object keys lexicographically.
common.finite_numbers: All floats are finite IEEE-754 binary64; NaN and Infinity are prohibited.

nested_schemas.checkpoint_state: Exact C15 v4 tensor-name set and shapes protected by the recursive C17-v1 manifest; all names must match the selected candidate checkpoint, values must be finite, and extra tensors are forbidden.

ordering_and_integrity: All arrays use declared compound order and reject duplicate compound keys.
Every artifact repeats protocol_id exactly; resource_conditions also repeats run_id exactly.
primary_candidate is null iff eligible_candidates is empty; otherwise it equals eligible_candidates[0].
Every selected candidate has exactly five complete control rows; each is same-size, target-disjoint, train-pool-contained, and deterministically reproducible.
Candidate absence has exactly five not_applicable_candidate_absent rows with nullable membership fields and complete=false.
All derived rows, dynamic feasibility counts, cardinalities, metrics, and gates recalculate from retained raw rows.
The exact-ten inventory has no extra files; canonical JSON/JSONL and UTF-8 LF report bytes are mandatory.
acceptance_matrix has exactly four secondary_cell_status_rows ordered by four secondary condition IDs; primary_rescue_allowed is always false.
reproduction_compare_manifest satisfies exact top-level and nested schemas and is rejected on any extra key, null, order mismatch, hash mismatch, or non-true all_equal.
Every discovery row control_feasibility_contract_sha256 equals frozen preregistered digest.
Every complete control row selection_input_sha256 recalculates from exact registered preimage; candidate-absence rows keep it null.

types.member_active_episode_counts: object whose keys exactly equal member_ids and values are nonnegative integers

types.all_equal: boolean; must be true for publication
types.equal_files: exact array[9 string], equal to prefinal_inventory when all_equal=true

types.combined_sha256: lowercase sha256 of the registered combined preimage
types.file_sha256: exact object with the nine prefinal_inventory keys and lowercase sha256 values; no extras
types.protocol_sha256: lowercase sha256 of raw pinned preregistration.json canonical UTF-8 bytes including exactly one LF
types.source_commit: 40 lowercase hexadecimal commit, identical to pinned prereg source_commit

types.gate_id: one of eight seed-local gate IDs

types.dev_mapping_rates: exact object keys 0,1,2,3 to finite float
types.non_target_activation_rates: exact object keys 0,1,2,3 to finite float|null

artifacts.candidate_absence_contract: Emit one normal discovery row with primary_candidate null, eligible_candidates empty, absence_reason set, and five not_applicable_candidate_absent control rows. This is a scientific negative and may be engineering-complete; it is not a failed seed.
artifacts.canonical_jsonl: one canonical JSON object plus LF per row; empty JSONL is zero bytes

dynamic_candidate_scaling.policy: Never substitute a preregistered static candidate count for a measured dynamic count.

artifacts.publication: Generate both pre-final exact-nine staging bundles, validate and compare them externally, then atomically publish only the final exact-ten bundle. No pre-final bundle is an official output.

claim_boundary.c08_negative: CL-008 remains E0; historical pair [9,14] and its unavailable development target are never C17 inputs, labels, controls, or success evidence.
claim_boundary.c16_boundary: Only C16 CC0/CC1 are supported at the registered synthetic boundary; CC2/CC3 remain not_supported and no grade is an organ label.
claim_boundary.scientific_claim: Only condition-scoped functional-organ candidates may be reported after every R0 scientific gate passes; no human semantic, biological, autonomous-organ, consciousness, AGI, energy, or external-generalization claim.

controls.activity_matched: exact target member count minimizing absolute active-step-count difference

construction_domain.candidate_feasible: non_target_pool_count>=target_member_count and same_size_control_subset_count>=1; this eligibility condition exists for the four matched types.
construction_domain.duplicate_subset_across_types: allowed; five distinct typed raw rows remain mandatory
construction_domain.matched_four_types: size_matched, degree_matched, load_matched, and activity_matched select from combinations(sorted non-target member IDs,target_member_count).
construction_domain.random_unmatched: Uses registered requested size 1..4 clipped to non_target_pool_count; it is not target-size matched.

control_feasibility_contract.field_order: canonical JSON sort_keys lexicographic order; arrays retain displayed order

controls.degree_matched: exact target member count minimizing L1 weighted incident message-degree difference
controls.load_matched: exact target member count minimizing absolute normalized activation-mass difference
controls.missing_control: For a selected candidate, missing, wrong-size, target-overlapping, or out-of-pool membership fails the whole seed closed before dev/test/heldout and science is not evaluated. Candidate absence uses explicit not_applicable_candidate_absent rows and may remain engineering-complete.
controls.random_unmatched: v1 size-hash rule with fresh namespace: requested_size=1+int(sha256(c17v2|control|{run_seed}|{condition_id})[:8],16)%4; selected_size=min(requested_size,len(sorted non-target pool)); choose the combination minimizing outer SHA-256 of the lowercase inner SHA-256 of canonical JSON sorted subset

field_values.metric_by_member: null for random_unmatched; exact sorted-ID object to 0.0 for size_matched; exact sorted-ID object to weighted incident degree, activation mass, or active-step count for corresponding matched type; domain is every train-bank member ID including target members
field_values.non_target_pool_member_ids: sorted array of train-bank member IDs excluding target_member_ids
field_values.target_member_ids: sorted array of selected candidate member IDs
field_values.target_metric_total: null for random_unmatched; 0.0 for size_matched; sum of corresponding metric_by_member values over target_member_ids for degree/load/activity

selection_input_contract.sha256: selection_input_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of these exact bytes

controls.size_matched: exact target member count; hash tie-break
controls.state_contract: All branches use the same episode/checkpoint/proposal fixture; C16 bank, C14 gate/belief, and C15 assessment state restore byte-exactly.

c17_v1.reproduction_scope: All exact-nine bytes matched, but the original execution hashseed was not recorded; no distinct-hashseed claim.

determinism.pythonhashseed_reproduction: Two isolated pre-final exact-nine staging runs use PYTHONHASHSEED 11801 and 21801. Only an external compare/finalize process may validate both and mark reproduction_exact.
determinism.timeout: terminate/join 5 seconds then kill/join 5 seconds; late normal exit never authorizes publication; surviving staging is quarantined
determinism.worker_boundary: Each generation worker owns one quarantined staging root and cannot set reproduction pass. A separate compare/finalize mode validates both roots and alone creates external evidence.

discovery.candidate_absence_interpretation: No eligible candidate after train-only feasibility filtering is science not_supported and may be engineering-complete. A selected candidate whose controls later violate the frozen contract is engineering implementation_failure and science not_evaluated_implementation_failure.
discovery.cross_seed: Never align candidate identity; count only same dev-mapped evaluator function with independently passing seed-local gates.
discovery.dev_target_mapping: Argmax candidate activation rate over the four evaluator functions on dev only; tie uses frozen function_order; freeze before test/heldout.

eligibility.train_only_control_feasibility: Apply after activity/episode eligibility and before ranking. The pool is the sorted train-bank candidate IDs excluding target members; dev/test/heldout and evaluator fields are unavailable.

discovery.formation: Per run_seed/resource cell on train only; dev/test/heldout are frozen query only.

failure_contract.any_failed_seed: engineering implementation_failure; science not_evaluated_implementation_failure; no bootstrap
failure_contract.atomic_unit: One run_seed across all five cells and all phases.
failure_contract.candidate_absence: Not a failed seed. Emit explicit absence/N-A control rows, calculate engineering gates, and record science not_supported without inventing target metrics.
failure_contract.existing_output: New output remains absent; existing empty output remains empty; nonempty output is never overwritten.
failure_contract.failed_seed_behavior: Discard whole seed buffer, record one failure, never retry, continue later seeds; successful rows remain descriptive.
failure_contract.global_failure: Preflight, serialization, integrity, or timeout aborts publication and never fabricates a failed seed.
failure_contract.selected_candidate_missing_control: Discard the whole seed before any frozen query evaluation; engineering implementation_failure, science not_evaluated_implementation_failure, and no bootstrap.
failure_contract.zero_success: Publish the registered exact-ten only after two deterministic pre-final exact-nine staging bundles and external comparison; candidate_discovery.jsonl is zero bytes, dynamic arrays are empty, static definitions and common failed_seeds remain, and no metrics are invented.

fixtures.amplitude: For every nonzero coordinate j add 0.02*(2*U(text)-1), clip [0,1], where text='c17v2|amplitude|'+run_seed+'|'+split+'|composition'+compositionality+'|'+episode_index+'|'+t+'|'+j and U=int(sha256(text)[:13],16)/2**52.
fixtures.composition: f=episode_index mod 4; ordinary composition2=[f,f+1], heldout composition2=[f,f+2], ordinary composition3=[f,f+1,f+2], heldout composition3=[f,f+2,f+3], all mod 4
fixtures.full_document: manifest order plus every frame with t, opaque identities, base_values, evaluator fields, entity key, hypotheses, and actions
function_values: temporal_memory: channel target_bit at local step 0; channel10=0.4 at final local step
contradiction_integration: channel 4+(1-target_bit) at penultimate local step; channel 4+target_bit otherwise

base_values_ordered_algorithm: Apply exactly one function branch: f0 sets target_bit at local step 0 and independently ch10=0.4 at the final local step; f1 sets 2+(target_bit XOR entity_index); f2 sets 4+(1-target_bit) at the penultimate local step and 4+target_bit otherwise; f3 sets 6+((target_bit+local_step)%2).
For j=0..11 leave zero unchanged; otherwise add the registered binary64 amplitude delta and clamp min(1.0,max(0.0,value+delta)).

amplitude.application: only coordinates nonzero after function and context writes; clamp without rounding

hash_and_serialization.canonical_json: CPython 3.11 json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')); UTF-8 without BOM or trailing LF
hash_and_serialization.numeric_semantics: IEEE-754 binary64 in stated operation order; no rounding or quantization
hash_and_serialization.sha256: SHA-256 lowercase hex of stated UTF-8 bytes

hash_documents.fixture_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical full corpus without trailing LF
hash_documents.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical manifest projection without trailing LF
hash_documents.repetition: The four composition2 cells repeat episode bytes except enclosing condition_id; R4 uses composition3.

identifiers.digest_rule: UTF-8 preimage, lowercase SHA-256, first 24 hex, literal prefix; decimal substitutions have no sign, padding, or whitespace.

manifest.transformation: Preserve corpus/cell/split/episode order and replace frames with frame_count=len(frames)=12.

fixtures.identity_fields: sample/source/group/entity/hypothesis/action IDs are c17v2-namespaced SHA-256 prefixes containing no split/function/target/truth text.
fixtures.manifest_document: canonical corpus projection retaining ordered cells/splits/episode metadata and replacing frames with frame_count

metrics.accuracy: correct/eligible; no-ignition is incorrect when sufficient target is registered and otherwise explicit
metrics.control_excess: targeted impairment minus each individual control impairment
metrics.functional_selectivity: locked-target activation rate minus max non-target activation rate
metrics.held_out_reuse: mean(unablated correct AND targeted wrong AND candidate active) on locked-target related-unseen heldout episodes
metrics.primary_aggregate: R0 also requires paired seed-block 95% bootstrap lower bounds for reuse, impairment, and all five control margins, plus upper bound for collateral; all five seeds complete.
metrics.targeted_impairment: test locked-target unablated accuracy minus targeted accuracy

proposal_assessment_boundary.assessment: C15 v4 is assessment-only; learned output is allow, veto, or abstain after a proposal.
proposal_assessment_boundary.context: C14 context Ignition constructs persistent history without learned veto.
hard_rules: C15 cannot create or replace a proposal
proposal canonical hash is invariant under assessment
stage role is scheduler metadata and never model input
proposal_assessment_boundary.proposal: Unchanged C14 bounded Coalition is the only proposal source.
proposal_assessment_boundary.test_exclusion: Test/heldout fixtures, mappings, outcomes, and labels cannot affect training, checkpoint selection, or calibration.
proposal_assessment_boundary.training: One C17 assessment checkpoint per run_seed is trained on R0 train and selected/calibrated on disjoint R0 dev partitions; the frozen checkpoint is shared by all resource cells.

protected_hash_manifest.c17_v1_recursive_protection: Validate the frozen v1 preregistration raw hash, parse it, and validate every c08/c14/c15/c16/release_and_claim_boundaries entry in its protected_hash_manifest; this transitively and directly preserves C06/C08/package/schema/release evidence without duplicating mutable authority.

external_compare_manifest.combined_sha256: For each run, SHA-256 of canonical JSON for ordered [[filename,file_sha256],...] in prefinal_inventory order, without LF.

combined_sha256_preimage.object: ordered array of nine two-item arrays [[filename,file_sha256],...]

external_compare_manifest.comparison_input_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for [comparison_contract_id,prefinal_inventory,runs] after validating each run independently, without LF.

file_sha256_schema.order: prefinal_inventory order for combined-hash construction; JSON object bytes remain canonical sort_keys
file_sha256_schema.types: each value is lowercase sha256 of that staging file complete raw bytes

protocol_sha256_preimage.bytes: The exact raw bytes of the pinned preregistration.json published in the final exact-ten bundle: canonical UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one LF.
protocol_sha256_preimage.cycle_boundary: The pinned preregistration contains no compare-manifest hash and no final acceptance/report hash. The same prereg bytes are present in both pre-final staging roots and the final bundle, so this hash is non-circular.
protocol_sha256_preimage.stage: Use the authorized four-field pinned preregistration with nonnull base_commit/base_sha256/source_commit and runner_execution_allowed=true. Never use the disabled preregistration hash.

types.all_equal: boolean; must be true for publication
types.equal_files: exact array[9 string], equal to prefinal_inventory when all_equal=true

validation: Reject any missing or extra top-level, run, file_sha256, or comparison-input key.
Require prefinal_inventory and equal_files to equal the registered exact-nine order.
Require exactly two run rows ordered A then B with distinct fixed PYTHONHASHSEED values.
Require both source_commit and protocol_sha256 values to be identical across A and B.
Recalculate every raw file hash, combined_sha256, comparison_input_sha256, and all_equal.
Publish only when all_equal=true and equal_files contains all nine names.

reproduction.finalization: External finalizer validates both staging bundles, writes canonical compare manifest, hashes its raw bytes, reconstructs pending pre-final acceptance/report in memory to verify manifest hashes, then deterministically regenerates final acceptance/report from core plus manifest evidence. The manifest never hashes itself or final acceptance/report.
reproduction.self_claim_prohibited: Generation workers and generate_bundle APIs cannot accept or emit reproduction_exact=True. Only validated external compare-manifest evidence can pass reproduction_exact.

resource_conditions.validator: Every secondary row differs from R0 in exactly one numeric factor; R0/R2/R3 require identical pre-resource bank hashes.

source_control.implementation_policy: After disabled v2 preregistration, implement only the seven allowlisted paths with reserved pure fixtures. v1 source/artifacts, v03_organs/__init__.py, C06/C08/C14/C15/C16, v0.2, package/schema/version/release files, accepted artifacts, and root initializers remain protected.

pin_contract.enabled_values: base_commit is the disabled-prereg commit; base_sha256 is the raw SHA-256 of this disabled preregistration; source_commit is the independently audited exact-seven source commit; runner_execution_allowed is true.
pin_contract.semantic_diff: From disabled bytes, exactly base_commit, base_sha256, source_commit, and runner_execution_allowed may change; all other values and bytes are immutable.

pin_order: commit disabled v2 preregistration and append-only decision/protocol
implement only exact-seven allowlisted source/tests with reserved pure fixtures
source-only commit and independent audit; do not execute official model/controller
separate four-field pin amendment enables runner
repeat focused/full/readiness and pure-fixture checks using reserved seeds only
generate isolated official pre-final staging A
generate isolated reproduction pre-final staging B
external compare/finalize creates manifest and atomically publishes exact ten
independent raw recalculation and protected-byte audit
source_control.preflight: Require disabled prereg raw hash and authorized exact four-field pin, committed bytes, source-pin ancestry, exact-seven allowlist diff, all protected hashes including v1 exact-nine/source, fresh fixture hashes, dependency pins, external compare capability, and absent/empty new output.

statistics.bootstrap: One random.Random(5817); sample five seed positions with replacement then locked-target episodes with replacement within each sampled seed; identical sampled blocks for all branches.
statistics.controls: intersection over every individual control; no best-control selection
statistics.failed_seed: no bootstrap; effects/bounds/counts null; no dropping or imputation
statistics.interval: percentile 95%, rank=(N-1)*p linear interpolation; point estimates use all complete paired raw rows
statistics.pairing: within run_seed, condition, opaque episode ID, intervention branch
statistics.secondary_cells: descriptive preregistered moderator effects only; never rescue R0

C15 creates or replaces a proposal
candidate discovery receives evaluator labels or dev/test/heldout outcomes
candidate eligibility omits same-size control feasibility or reads non-train data
selected candidate lacks any complete same-size train-only control
external compare manifest is absent, invalid, circular, or not byte-equal
protected bytes change, including C17 v1 exact-nine/source
official seed/model/controller execution before source pin
tests_before_official_execution: two independent pure-fixture implementations reproduce every fresh hash without importing model/controller
resource validator proves one changed factor per secondary cell
renaming evaluator labels preserves discovery bytes
dev/test/heldout mutation preserves train bank, feasibility counts, and discovery bytes
C14 proposal hash invariant to C15 allow/veto/abstain and alternate proposals unrepresentable
candidate absent/tie/size boundaries, n<m/n=m pool boundaries, and all exact-size controls deterministic
selected-candidate missing/wrong-size/overlap/out-of-pool controls fail the whole seed before frozen queries
candidate absence produces five N/A controls and remains engineering-completable science not_supported
ablation restore exact and frozen inspection nonmutating
all exact schemas, compound order, cardinalities, dynamic feasibility counts, metrics, and gates recalculate
seed failure, zero-success, timeout, quarantine, nonempty-output, and invalid manifest fail closed

generation APIs cannot self-claim reproduction; only external compare/finalize can pass the gate
